summary: Document the Phase 4 requirement that a pool master reconciles applicable pool-wide network and storage configuration to joining members through Core-to-Core operations. API impact: new/changed Core-to-Core contract when Phase 4 is implemented; this planning change alters no runtime API.

guide.reason: Member join is not implemented, so no operator workflow exists to document.

api.reason: The plan records a future Core-to-Core contract; no implemented API reference changes.

roadmap.reason: Phase 4 remains planned and the published roadmap already lists multi-host pools as outstanding.

state.reason: The future member-join configuration and per-member reconciliation outcomes are pool-scoped state owned by Nex Core, not Controller.
state.record: Planned durable pool-membership and configuration-generation records on the pool master, with Core-to-Core member results reported through inventory so a fresh Controller re-adopts the same pool configuration and per-member status.

verification.method: Reviewed the Phase 4 roadmap against the VLAN and storage plans; ran the documentation gate and repository privacy check.
